title: Cheese Patties in Tomato Sauce
subtitle: pan-fried and simmered
description: Salty white cheese patties bound with egg and bread are fried until golden, then simmered in a garlicky grated tomato sauce.

steps.text: Grate the cheese, crumble the bread and mix with the eggs. Season with pepper (and a little salt if needed).
For the sauce, heat 2 tablespoons oil with the garlic in a wide pot. When fragrant, add the paprika, grated tomatoes, salt and pepper. Cover and cook over low heat.
Heat oil for frying in a frying pan.
Shape patties using two spoons and fry for 2 minutes on each side until browned.
Transfer the patties to the sauce and simmer for 5 minutes until the patties are firm.
